body: So last spawn we had Ranks that were very useful mostly in The Walls but still useful now with the new spawn and new nebula maps. so on the Ranks you can buy have completely been not needed such as: non-Ranks picking there team. that is one of the many things they now can do so yes we can get more X.P but don't you see, the people who support this server should have something that others can't so yes we do get X.P but you can vote for that! So yes we can do /surface but is that the legit best thing we can use? I Payed 50$ to this server why because i loved walls and i loved nebula and i wish i donated to get something amazing something that us donors can get to make are time on this great server a one to not miss.
